title: plantago coronopus var. commutata
intro: Plantago coronopus var. commutata, commonly known as buck's horn plantain, is a perennial plant in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of buck's horn plantain include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The plant has been used to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable medicinal plant in various traditional and modern applications.
